We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

sup:DEMO-C1.text:
Dear partner,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our proposal and are very keen to win your business and demonstrate our capabilities as a reliable, long-term partner. For this position, our offer includes a price of €16.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and delivery EXW.

We look forward to the opportunity of working together and building a successful partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Please let us know if you have any questions.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

move.text:
Dear partner,
Thank you very much for your message - we are very glad about your interest in our company.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €16.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Thank you for sharing the details of the alternative offer; we are eager to demonstrate our value as a reliable partner.
We can accept your requested 30-day payment and 35-day lead time to support your schedule.
Any further step needs approval from our management.
Alternatively, with delivery EXW: €15.90 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.
We are fully committed to winning your business and to becoming a long-term partner for your team.
Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
